methodology: SMART Kanban with team-lead orchestration and evaluator-driven self-improvement inspired by OpenEvolve/AlphaEvolve-style loops.

agents.name: Team Lead Agent
agents.mission: Own task flow, WIP limits, dependency checks, handoffs, and merge-readiness.

agents.name: Task Curator Agent
agents.mission: Review, add, update, split, close, and delete SMART tasks weekly.

agents.name: Research Agent
agents.mission: Track current Windows game technology and design research.

agents.name: Architecture Agent
agents.mission: Own engine ADRs, module boundaries, and interfaces.

agents.name: Rendering Agent
agents.mission: Own D3D12 renderer, frame timing, terrain, tunnels, and visual readability.

agents.name: Asset Streaming Agent
agents.mission: Own DirectStorage, asset packaging, compression, streaming benchmarks, and fallbacks.

agents.name: Input Agent
agents.mission: Own keyboard, mouse, controller, HOTAS, rebinding, and accessibility input.

agents.name: Flight Feel Agent
agents.mission: Own arcade 6DOF control, collision, assist, camera, and motion-comfort feel.

agents.name: Weapons Agent
agents.mission: Own weapons, lock-on, damage tags, projectiles, and hidden caches.

agents.name: Enemy AI Agent
agents.mission: Own fighters, turrets, SAMs, bosses, and enemy behavior tests.

agents.name: Mission Agent
agents.mission: Own objective graphs, triggers, switches, doors, checkpoints, and vertical slice scripting.

agents.name: UX/HUD Agent
agents.mission: Own HUD, compass, nav computer, map, subtitles, and settings.

agents.name: Audio Agent
agents.mission: Own callouts, weapon audio, music states, subtitle triggers, and mix.

agents.name: Build/CI Agent
agents.mission: Own CMake, GitHub Actions, packaging, crash logs, and Windows 11 compatibility.

agents.name: QA/Evaluator Agent
agents.mission: Own tests, benchmarks, evaluator scoring, playtest instrumentation, and regression gates.

agents.name: Art Direction Agent
agents.mission: Own retro-futurist style guide, asset briefs, and readability standards.

tasks.title: Stand up the agent operating model
tasks.specific: Define team-lead assignment rules, WIP limits, blockers, handoff rules, and merge gate policy.
tasks.measurable: agents/AGENTS.md and agents/TEAM_LEAD_AGENT.md exist and are linked from README; WIP limit is documented.
tasks.achievable: Documentation-only task with no engine dependency.
tasks.relevant: Enables parallel agents to work without overlap or unmanaged drift.

tasks.title: Create recurring task review process
tasks.specific: Create the weekly process to review, add, update, split, close, or delete tasks.
tasks.measurable: PM-002 exists as a recurring task and tasks/KANBAN.md documents task-change rules.
tasks.achievable: Uses current board files only.
tasks.relevant: Keeps the project self-correcting as new research and playtest data arrive.

tasks.title: Create Windows 11 game-tech research watchlist
tasks.specific: Summarise DirectStorage, D3D12, GameInput, PIX, shader delivery, and evolutionary coding references.
tasks.measurable: docs/00_RESEARCH_NOTES.md contains actionable research items and source links.
tasks.achievable: Research-only seed task.
tasks.relevant: Prevents stale technology assumptions.

tasks.title: Define homage and IP guardrails
tasks.specific: Define what can and cannot be reused from 1990s inspiration titles.
tasks.measurable: docs/IP_AND_BRAND_GUARDRAILS.md lists prohibited reuse, allowed homage patterns, review checklist, and naming policy.
tasks.achievable: Documentation-only task.
tasks.relevant: Allows an ode without unsafe copying.

tasks.title: Write engine architecture ADR
tasks.specific: Compare custom C++/D3D12, Unreal, and Unity for the vertical slice.
tasks.measurable: ADR scores at least 3 options against DirectStorage, renderer control, speed, tooling, staffing, and Windows 11 compatibility, then selects one.
tasks.achievable: Decision document only.
tasks.relevant: Prevents the team building on the wrong technical base.

tasks.title: Create minimal CMake Windows application skeleton
tasks.specific: Create a C++23 CMake app that builds and self-tests.
tasks.measurable: cmake configure, build, and ctest run against hellbindah_boot.
tasks.achievable: Small native app already scaffolded.
tasks.relevant: Provides the first executable baseline.

tasks.title: Set up GitHub Actions CI for Windows builds
tasks.specific: Run configure, build, tests, and task JSON validation on every PR.
tasks.measurable: A PR shows passing CI on windows-latest and ubuntu-latest.
tasks.achievable: Uses CMake and Python scripts already in repo.
tasks.relevant: Gates every agent change with repeatable checks.

tasks.title: Convert concept into vertical-slice GDD
tasks.specific: Define the first 12-15 minute mission, weapons, enemies, objective chain, secrets, and fail/success states.
tasks.measurable: docs/01_GAME_DESIGN_BRIEF.md includes a mission beat table with at least 12 beats and 10 acceptance criteria.
tasks.achievable: Documentation and data-design only.
tasks.relevant: Gives all implementation agents the same target.

tasks.title: Prototype input abstraction
tasks.specific: Implement an input layer for keyboard/mouse, controller, and future HOTAS bindings.
tasks.measurable: Sample logs thrust, pitch, yaw, roll, fire, turbo, weapon-next, map, and pause actions from at least two input families.
tasks.achievable: Prototype can start with mocked GameInput/SDL backends.
tasks.relevant: Flight feel depends on reliable input abstraction.

tasks.title: Implement arcade 6DOF flight prototype
tasks.specific: Create arcade thrust, brake, turbo, pitch, yaw, roll, strafe, auto-level, and assist toggles.
tasks.measurable: Manual test scene can fly through 10 gates in under 90 seconds with keyboard and controller; movement tests pass.
tasks.achievable: Standalone prototype before full renderer.
tasks.relevant: Core feel is the product.

tasks.title: Create D3D12 renderer spike
tasks.specific: Render one moving ship proxy, one terrain proxy, and HUD timing at 1080p.
tasks.measurable: Spike hits 1080p/60 on a Windows 11 dev machine or produces an ADR rejecting D3D12 for v0.1.
tasks.achievable: Limited scene with no production art.
tasks.relevant: Validates the custom-engine path.

tasks.title: Benchmark DirectStorage 1.4 feasibility
tasks.specific: Measure asset load paths using DirectStorage 1.4 preview concepts and fallback file IO.
tasks.measurable: Report includes load times, CPU cost, GPU decompression viability, Zstd/GDeflate notes, packaging constraints, and recommendation for v0.1/v1.0.
tasks.achievable: Benchmark-only task with synthetic assets.
tasks.relevant: Open terrain and tunnel transitions depend on streaming.

tasks.title: Define weapon data schema
tasks.specific: Create data schema for cannon, spread, laser, rocket, lock-on, cluster, energy-return, and mine weapons.
tasks.measurable: Schema validates 10 weapon definitions and rejects malformed configs with useful errors.
tasks.achievable: Can be pure JSON/Python before engine integration.
tasks.relevant: Keeps weapons data-driven and evaluator-friendly.

tasks.title: Define mission objective graph schema
tasks.specific: Create a graph schema for objectives, switches, doors, checkpoints, hidden caches, and extraction.
tasks.measurable: A vertical-slice mission file validates and renders as a dependency graph with at least 12 nodes.
tasks.achievable: Can be implemented as JSON plus validator.
tasks.relevant: Mission systems drive the vertical slice.

tasks.title: Prototype compass and objective HUD
tasks.specific: Create compass, objective range, altitude delta, status, and debug telemetry display.
tasks.measurable: In a test mission, 90% of testers reach the next objective within 60 seconds without external instructions.
tasks.achievable: Can use placeholder UI.
tasks.relevant: The game must be fast without becoming confusing.

tasks.title: Prototype fighter, turret, and SAM AI
tasks.specific: Create one dogfighting fighter, three turrets, and one missile-lock SAM in a test arena.
tasks.measurable: Fighter reaches engagement range within 10 seconds, fires, can be destroyed, and SAM lock warning appears.
tasks.achievable: Uses placeholder geometry and weapon stubs.
tasks.relevant: Combat pressure validates flight and HUD feel.

tasks.title: Build vertical-slice mission blockout
tasks.specific: Build surface base, hatch switch, tunnel route, reactor room, hidden cache, timed escape, and extraction point.
tasks.measurable: A tester can complete the full mission loop from start to extraction with placeholder art and logged metrics.
tasks.achievable: Depends on first runtime prototypes, not final art.
tasks.relevant: This is the first playable Hellbindah experience.

tasks.title: Create evaluator scorecard for agentic development
tasks.specific: Create an evaluator that scores candidate changes for build, tests, performance, task hygiene, IP safety, and regression risk.
tasks.measurable: evolution/evaluator.py returns 0-100, hard-fails unsafe changes, and has at least 5 sample inputs with expected scores.
tasks.achievable: Python-only evaluator scaffold.
tasks.relevant: Enables OpenEvolve-style selection rather than random coding.

tasks.title: Enable self-improving scoped-code loop
tasks.specific: Run an OpenEvolve-style loop against safe tuning/config files only.
tasks.measurable: Demo generates at least 5 candidate changes, accepts improvements, rejects regressions, and records score history.
tasks.achievable: Limited to non-critical tuning/data files until trust grows.
tasks.relevant: Implements the requested self-evolving process safely.

tasks.title: Review, add, update, split, close, and delete tasks
tasks.specific: Run the weekly task-board review and modify tasks based on evidence.
tasks.measurable: Each review considers at least one add, update, split, close, and delete action and logs rationale.
tasks.achievable: Recurring governance task with TL-01 review.
tasks.relevant: Maintains the living plan and Kanban board.

tasks.title: Assign next sprint tasks based on dependencies and capacity
tasks.specific: Move ready work into Doing and assign it to agents based on dependencies and WIP limits.
tasks.measurable: Weekly assignment note lists each agent, active tasks, blockers, and next handoff; no Doing task lacks owner or due date.
tasks.achievable: Uses tasks/tasks.json and issue status labels.
tasks.relevant: Keeps parallel work coordinated.
